name: sdlc
description: Full Claude Code SDLC pipeline with 21 skills: a 12-stage map-architecture to ship backbone, interview ideation (feature and greenfield project modes with an easy/medium/hard depth regulator), a scaffold skill that materializes a new project from the base-tpl template with subtractive batteries, and 7 cross-cutting utilities. Includes prepare-design-spec for one repository-aware UI design spec with an embedded Definition of Done, verify-ui for live browser evidence, and user-documentation for end-user docs generated from a live app (playwright-cli walks, per-flow doc-flow subagents, screenshots and optional screencast replays). Per-feature artifacts live under docs/features/<slug>/; skills own their templates and end with explicit stage handoffs.
